roomSummary: This is a two-room open-plan suite featuring a spacious front living area connected via a wide cased opening to a bright dining room in the rear, both lined with dark carpet.
camera: The camera stands in the front living space looking diagonally across the dark carpet toward the wide opening into the dining room and the curtained window along the right wall.

landmarks.description: patterned floor-to-sill curtains covering a large window on the right wall
wide cased opening leading into the rear dining room
back window in the adjoining room flanked by grey curtains
side window on the right wall of the adjoining room
wall outlet and adapter located on the lower wall beneath the right patterned curtains near the corner

walls.name: Right curtained wall
walls.description: The exterior wall on the right lined with patterned drapery and a power outlet below.

walls.name: Centre partition wall
walls.description: The structural wall section between the wide opening and the right corner.

walls.name: Rear dining room back wall
walls.description: The far wall of the adjoining room featuring a wide window.

zones.name: Living Zone
zones.description: The open foreground room in front of the camera.

zones.name: Dining Zone
zones.description: The bright adjoining room viewed through the wide cased opening.

diningSpace.reason: The dedicated adjoining room through the wide opening has sufficient open floor area to easily accommodate a full 4 to 6-seat dining table without obstructing any entryways or windows.

layout.placement: centred on the carpeted floor in the main foreground living space
positioned on the foreground rug facing toward the patterned curtain wall on the right
centred on the living area rug in front of the three-seater sofa
placed on the edge of the rug near the centre partition wall, angled toward the coffee table
freestanding in the centre of the adjoining rear room, framed by the wide cased opening
four to six chairs arranged neatly around the dining table in the rear room

relationships: The living area seating is grouped cohesively on an area rug in the foreground, leaving a direct walking route through the wide opening into the dining room.
The dining suite remains entirely within the adjoining rear room.
avoid: Do not place furniture inside the wide cased opening that blocks circulation between the two rooms.
Do not place high-backed furniture directly against the patterned curtains on the right.
Do not cover the electrical outlets on the wall beneath the patterned curtains.
keepUntouched: The patterned curtains covering the right-hand window.
The window frames and curtains in the rear dining room.
The power outlet and plug on the lower wall under the curtains.
The dark grey wall-to-wall carpeting and white architectural trims.
